(POST) /api/users/login

(DELETE) /api/users/:id

    with open(file_path, 'r') as file:

    words = text.split()

    # Convert all the words to lowercase

    # Use a dictionary to store the word frequencies
    word_count = {}
    for word in words:

            word_count[word] += 1
        else:
            word_count[word] = 1

    # Print the word frequencies
    for word, count in word_count.items():
        print(f"{word}: {count}")
